svg.title: Human LLM Council
svg.desc: Human LLM Council: a small local model of one person's judgement that reviews what AI agents send and stops what that person would reject, scored on the decisions where the person overrode the agent. The benchmark is 375 held-out decisions; set before any training, a trained model must reach 70.6% overall and 24.5% on the decisions where I overrode the agent; a training test on synthetic data peaked at 3.34 GB of VRAM on a 6 GB laptop GPU. No model is trained on real data yet (preview). Frames: the held-out results chart, then the self-consistency retest page on synthetic sample questions. Opens github.com/Sohwhat6420/human-llm-council.
